For this product both listings are effectively identical **except for one important difference** - you should buy from **Seller A - [Brackmoor Sound](https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/q44ses/a)**.

Here is the comparison based on the two pages:

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Shipping** | Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days, In stock | Same |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping | Same |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | Same |
| **Warranty listed** | 1-year limited warranty | Same |
| **Dealer Status** | **Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.** | **No claim of authorized dealer status listed** |

### Why A is the better choice:

Both sellers offer the same price, shipping, returns, and stated 1-year warranty, so there is no cost or convenience advantage to either one.

The tie-breaker is that **Brackmoor Sound explicitly states it is an Authorized Quellwyn dealer and that you get the Full manufacturer warranty.** Ottervale Audio does not make that claim.

Buying from an authorized dealer gives you:

1.  **Guarantee of authenticity** - you are getting a genuine Quellwyn product, not grey-market / third-party stock
2.  **Warranty will be honored** - many manufacturers will only honor the 1-year limited warranty if purchased from an authorized seller. Even though both pages say "1-year limited warranty," only A guarantees it is the full manufacturer warranty.

Since there is no downside - same price and same terms - Brackmoor Sound (Seller A) is the lower-risk choice.
